verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own docs show issue triage: the MCP update_issue tool can resolve, unresolve, or ignore an issue, and the product is positioned as a place to triage and resolve errors. Nothing documents assigning an owner, snoozing, or automatically reopening a resolved issue when it regresses. Teams only govern who gets notified. missing for 10: assign-owner capability, snooze/time-bound ignore, automatic regression reopening, UI-level triage documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can triage issues — assign an owner, resolve, ignore, or snooze — and the platform reopens a resolved issue automatically when it regresses
